page: Google Cloud Platform tpu7x-standard-1t is a specialized accelerator instance designed for machine learning workloads. It features 56 dedicated vCPUs on an x86_64 architecture, paired with 240.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 4.29 GB of RAM per core. The primary hardware feature is a single integrated Google TPU v7x accelerator equipped with 192 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached storage options. Additionally, the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The hardware profile is highly optimized for resource density in deep learning tasks, trading off local storage and standard networking extras to maximize the cost efficiency of the dedicated TPU accelerator and system memory allocation.

Due to the presence of the Google TPU v7x with 192 GB of VRAM, this instance is engineered specifically for large-scale machine learning workloads. Suitable applications include deep learning model training, high-throughput neural network inference, natural language processing, and large-scale data science pipelines that can leverage TPU acceleration.
